summary: The vspone_block parameter names renamed in Ansible 14.0.0 are kept as aliases for backward compatibility but will be removed in the next major release.
questions: Do the old vspone_block parameter names still work in Ansible 14?
When will the vspone_block aliases be removed?

answer_card.title: vspone_block old names kept as aliases
answer_card.answer_md: The renamed parameters in hitachivantara.vspone_block (for example `nick_name`, `ports`, `port`, `start_ldev`, `mirror_unit_id`, `pvol_status`, `parity_group`, `copy_pace_track_size`) remain as **aliases** for backward compatibility but will be **removed in the next major release**. Update playbooks to the new names.
